description: Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations - Award made to the Industrial Dispute between Mr. J. M. M. Mahinda Bandara and Asha Shipping Limited, Colombo 03 (E only)
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the publication of an arbitration award under the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131. It details legal proceedings, evidence submission, and the resolution of an industrial dispute between an individual and a company through established legal/regulatory mechanisms. The content focuses on the application of labor laws and regulatory procedures rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
